title: Wisdom Builds Her House

questions.question: The wisest of women builds her house, but folly with her own hands does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:1 (ESV): "but folly with her own hands tears it down."

questions.question: Where there are no oxen, the manger is clean, but abundant crops come by the strength of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:4 (ESV): "but abundant crops come by the strength of the ox."

questions.question: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:12 (ESV): "but its end is the way to death."

questions.question: In all toil there is profit, but mere talk tends only to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:23 (ESV): "but mere talk tends only to poverty."

questions.question: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a reproach to any what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:34 (ESV): "but sin is a reproach to any people."

questions.question: A faithful witness does not lie, but a false witness breathes out what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:5 (ESV): "but a false witness breathes out lies."

questions.question: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares its what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:10 (ESV): "and no stranger shares its joy."

questions.question: The simple believes everything, but the prudent gives thought to his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:15 (ESV): "but the prudent gives thought to his steps."

questions.question: The poor is disliked even by his neighbor, but the rich has many what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:20 (ESV): "but the rich has many friends."

questions.question: In the fear of the Lord one has strong confidence, and his children will have a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:26 (ESV): "and his children will have a refuge."

questions.question: Leave the presence of a fool, for there you do not meet words of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:7 (ESV): "for there you do not meet words of knowledge."

questions.question: Fools mock at the guilt offering, but the upright enjoy what?
The backslider in heart will be filled with the fruit of his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:14 (ESV): "The backslider in heart will be filled with the fruit of his ways,"

questions.question: A tranquil heart gives life to the flesh, but envy makes the bones do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:30 (ESV): "but envy makes the bones rot."

questions.question: Whoever oppresses a poor man insults his Maker, but he who is generous to the needy does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 14:31 (ESV): "but he who is generous to the needy honors him."

key_verse_text: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death.
